Crop of one slip from a Players Committee Virtual card sheet, showing the label above the slip and the margin note beside the slip number, for [[Nizuc Bek (V)]]: the label and the margin note both print "•Nizuk Bek (V)"; the PC card image [[:File:VB3-D-nizucbek-pre.gif]] and the Decipher card [[Nizuc Bek]] print "Nizuc".

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]

Edits: the slip area was rendered from the PDF at 216 dpi and cropped; nothing else changed. Used on [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Slip labels and margin notes]].

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution excerpt of a Players Committee fan document showing copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game artwork (© Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to document the printed text on this non-commercial fan wiki.
